nav.announcement: Wondering how CIRCLE fits your organization?

landing.heroHeadline: Support that stays, when everything else changes.
landing.imageLabel: a Support Partner and member checking in
landing.testimonialQuote: It's not a call center — it's people who already know me.
landing.ctaBarBody: A Care Circle of Support Partners, prepared with your context every time. Reaching out isn't a weakness — we're here.
landing.aboutBody: CIRCLE is named for what it builds: a circle of consistent Support Partners around every member. Each Support Partner stays with you over time and works from context you shouldn't have to repeat, backed by human oversight at every step — so support stays personal, accountable, and never fully automated.
landing.value1Body: Every member is paired with a Primary and Secondary Support Partner suited to their situation — not just whoever's free.
landing.value2Body: The same Support Partners follow you over time, so you never have to repeat your story.
landing.value3Body: Every AI-drafted summary and flagged signal is reviewed and approved by a human Professional Lead before it counts.
landing.value4Body: Your circle — and emergency resources — stay reachable, not limited to scheduled sessions.
landing.ctaBody: Talk to us about setting up cohorts, Support Partners, and governance for your team.

about.heroTitle: A circle of people who actually know you
about.bodyLeft: CIRCLE is named for what it builds: a circle of consistent Support Partners around every member, matched to fit their situation — so the people supporting you actually have context, not a blank slate. Not a hotline that passes you along, but people who stay, reachable for whatever comes up.
about.bodyRight: We're starting with people navigating rehabilitation and major life transitions, pairing every member with a small, familiar team instead of a rotating cast of strangers. Every case is backed by human oversight, so support stays personal, accountable, and never fully automated. Over time, CIRCLE will grow to serve anyone who needs this kind of continuous, familiar support.
about.numbered1Body: Designed alongside the people who actually do this work day to day, not just from the outside.
about.numbered2Body: Every AI prompt, summary, and human override is logged — full transparency into what was sent and what came back.
about.numbered3Body: CIRCLE isn't a point solution — it's the continuity layer underneath how your organization already supports people.
about.missionBody: People going through rehabilitation and life transitions do best with consistency: the same voice, the same context, the same trust built over time. Most platforms optimize for whoever's available right now. CIRCLE optimizes for whoever already knows you.
about.roleMemberBody: The people receiving support — each paired with a small, consistent Care Circle instead of a rotating cast of strangers.
about.rolePartnerBody: The frontline team members who provide non-clinical support, prepared for every conversation with context instead of a blank slate.
about.roleLeadBody: Supervisors who oversee a cohort of Support Partners and review anything the system flags — the human decision-maker in the loop.
about.roleAdminBody: The team at a partner organization managing cohorts, staffing, and oversight for their members.
about.aiTitle: Where AI fits — and where it doesn't
about.aiBody: AI in CIRCLE drafts summaries, prepares context, and surfaces signals worth a second look. It never approves, decides, or acts on its own — every meaningful step ends with a human clicking approve.
